phone.notes: The boss of each dungeon floor is drawn with its Halloween skin and the floor tells you which skin its first win gives. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: For the Digimon of your farm you choose the evolution yourself (an EVOLVE button on each open form), and the wild fights and vitals follow numbers the game can tune from the server. If something breaks or feels unfair, tell us in #bug-reports.
